work_package: W07 independent approved static procedures and native Skills middleware
user_request_summary: 继续推进到实测前可完整审查节点，保证实际实现、当前文档与竞赛/论文贡献边界清楚。
goal: 完整批准指导可编译、冻结、原生 SDK 加载/注入及纯回读；启停不改变资源和权限。
changes: StaticSkillPolicy selects explicit sorted approved entries; host_curated only, run originals and external TaskKnowledgeBinding revalidated.
Complete SKILL.md retains premises, original unknown questions, procedure/observation branches, preserved behaviors, counterexamples, exits and canonical SolverProjection.
Separate frozen resource profile retains renderer/prompt/content identities and exact native metadata; KnowledgeSnapshot1.skill_files is unchanged.
Manifest-only backend supports native discovery/download, denies directory expansion, support scripts, read/write/edit/delete/grep/glob/upload and execution authority.
Native SkillsMiddleware loads on/off identical resources; on appends controlled catalog with read_skill instructions, off suppresses only catalog injection and preserves full body reads.
Service and middleware recompile approved projection and recheck complete run originals, exact names, hashes, shared files and cached metadata; local self-reported hashes do not replace approval.
Independent bounded resource/source/owner read phases close their originals; source/file/aggregate capacity, native truncation or partial publication cause explicit rejection.
Pydantic Literal true-to-1 coercion rejected by field prevalidation, preserving strict JSON-array admission; tests retain initial failures.
Updated existing guide, design, contracts, plan, usage and STATUS; no second task ledger or new permanent Markdown document.

scope_adjustment.reason: Parallel implementation agents failed on service usage limits; the batch was narrowed to one independently verifiable resource/middleware goal.
scope_adjustment.preservation_status: Ignored local unfinished drafts only; current code and reproducibility do not depend on archive.

validation.skip_reason: Actual symbolic-link creation requires unavailable Windows account privilege; no simulated test is claimed as actual link verification.

retained_failed_attempts.cause: Literal boolean coercion and test assuming unsupported middleware.tools attribute
Whole-model before hook changed strict JSON tuple admission; replaced with field hook
Test import formatting, fixed without semantic or budget changes

intermediate_success.reason: Before adding seven final adversarial/capacity cases; not counted twice

limitations: Standalone host and middleware hooks only: agent.py has no static profile or registered read_skill; no new session/report/completion/manifest generation is implemented.
Managed knowledge/applicability/static input, actual solver/tool-budget/receipt linkage, report capacity, comparison and portable export are the next integration gate.
Compiler authenticates approved snapshot and scope, not retrieval-index identity; caller admission uses knowledge_run before invoking it.
Resource phases are independently bounded, not a whole-run cumulative I/O or ASCII report/full-matrix capacity guarantee.
Synthetic native hook tests prove neither model decisions nor task-local static Skill use, cross-task learning, repair gains or research novelty.
Windows general long-path publication and actual symbolic-link cases still need integration validation; short fixture names do not establish long-path capability.
Feedback extraction, Skill evolution/qualification, cloud provider compatibility, application oracle and HarmonyOS build/device execution remain unimplemented or unknown.
next_work: W07 static Skill Agent/session/report/evaluation/export integration and managed approved knowledge configuration, before feedback/evolution and full offline review gates.
